automatedTests.note: Mocked Escape-origin case failed once during combined workload; whole lifecycle file and bounded Escape reruns passed unchanged. Actual browser Escape also passed on all five desktop feature cases.

scope: All source files/resources structurally validated; authentic first/middle/last reading targets inspected in every book on both production viewport sizes.
Representative feature workflows tested on eight books; phone viewport emulation is not a physical-device test.
No human proofreading claim for every page; original front matter, legal pages and image pixels are preserved.
Guest test contexts opt out of analytics; no private account data or authenticated backend user writes.
